$comment: Every secret or key MEGA uses. Values live only in .env.secrets (gitignored). targets: convex = pushed to the Convex deployment by `secrets sync-convex`; app = given to Expo commands by `secrets run` (under appName if set); tool = local scripts only. generate: the script can create the value. decode: how the stored value is encoded, so its decoded form is redacted too.

vars.name: META_API_KEY
vars.help: Meta Model API key (Muse Spark, Muse Image, Transcribe)

vars.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
vars.help: Random secret for Better Auth sessions. Run: node scripts/secrets.mjs gen BETTER_AUTH_SECRET

vars.name: GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID
vars.help: Google Cloud → Clients → Web application → Client ID

vars.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.help: Google Cloud → Clients → Web application → Client secret

vars.name: GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID
vars.help: Google Cloud → Clients → iOS → Client ID

vars.name: APPLE_CLIENT_ID
vars.help: Apple Services ID identifier (web sign-in), e.g. com.you.mega.web

vars.name: APPLE_TEAM_ID
vars.help: Apple Developer Team ID (10 characters, top right of the Membership page)

vars.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
vars.help: Key ID of the Sign in with Apple key (.p8)

vars.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_B64
vars.help: Don't paste this. Run: node scripts/secrets.mjs apple-key <path to AuthKey_XXXX.p8>

vars.name: DEMO_MODE
vars.help: Not a secret — set to exactly 'true' on a demo deployment to enable clock.jump and demo sign-in. Leave unset in prod.

vars.name: EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN
vars.help: Optional: expo.dev → Access tokens (for enhanced push security)

vars.name: PUSH_ANSWER_SECRET
vars.help: HMAC secret for POST /push/answer answer tokens (killed-app background answers, no session). Run: node scripts/secrets.mjs gen PUSH_ANSWER_SECRET

vars.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
vars.help: Optional: web search fallback. Off in config while we're all-Meta
